narrative: Saturday, October 24 starts at your own front door: out at 08:00, the airport buffer kept whole, a flight of about 120 minutes, and into Hôtel Marie Rollett around 12:45.
Expect a mild 11° — good walking weather, with layers for the shade.
The room is not promised until 14:30 — no room access is assumed before then, so the plan waits gently near base.
Lunch is at Don Vegan, 13:12–14:12.
The choice is backed by the restaurant's own listing, which marks it diet:vegan = only, diet:vegetarian = yes — the dietary need is provided for, not hoped for.
Because the kitchen is vegan-only, its menu carries no egg either; only shared-surface cross-contact can't be confirmed from listings, so a quick word on arrival is still wise.
Check-in is at 14:30 — bags down, keys in hand.
Then the plan stops on purpose: 60 minutes to rest and refresh. Travel is part of the trip, and it takes something out of you — the sights will keep.
Cannonball Tree fills 15:48–16:48 — long enough to enjoy properly, short enough to keep the day light.
Opening hours weren't listed for Cannonball Tree — worth a glance at the door, though the visit is set mid-day when places are likeliest to be open.
The day winds down back at base by 16:51 — 1 stops, no long walks, and the evening left free.

availabilityDataNote: early/late check-in AVAILABILITY is a live hotel state: no enrichment source carries it (Google Places has no check-in-time or room-readiness fields; OSM has none). What data CAN carry is the BOOKED check-in time (the booking confirmation — the envelope already labels it hotel/booking data) and, at travel time, the event itself (the desk, a hotel message). The engine therefore treats readiness strictly as an EVENT input with provenance "hotel event", never as a promised plan input.
